nodes.description: Public address state variable `owner`, initialized to msg.sender at deployment; used as the authorization anchor in the restricted modifier.
Public uint state variable storing the last completed migration index.
Caller-supplied address used both as the deployment-time owner and as the caller identity checked by the restricted modifier.
Modifier that requires msg.sender == owner before executing the modified function body (the `_` placeholder).
External public function guarded by the restricted modifier; writes the completed migration counter.
Input parameter `completed` of setCompleted, supplying the new value for the migration counter.
State-modifying assignment `last_completed_migration = completed`; sensitive write that is guarded by the restricted modifier.

edges.reason: owner is assigned msg.sender during contract construction, anchoring authorization to the deployer.
msg.sender is compared against owner inside the require statement of the restricted modifier, forming the access-control gate.
The restricted modifier must pass its require before setCompleted's body executes.
The restricted modifier controls whether the state write in setCompleted is reached.
Execution of setCompleted performs the guarded assignment to last_completed_migration.
setCompleted writes the completed value into the last_completed_migration state variable.
Parameter completed is passed into setCompleted as its only argument.
Parameter completed supplies the value used by the state-write operation.
Parameter completed flows into the last_completed_migration storage slot.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter `completed` is only meaningful as the input of setCompleted; it can be collapsed into the function node during normalization.
